scenes.say: This bird can sound exactly like a chainsaw.
Meet the lyrebird, from the forests of Australia.
scenes.heading: MEET THE

scenes.say: Males sing to impress females, copying the calls of more than twenty other bird species.
scenes.label: other bird species

scenes.say: But it doesn't stop at birds. Camera shutters. Car alarms.
scenes.heading: AND ALSO...

scenes.say: It copies whatever it hears around it.
Which means some lyrebirds are singing the sound of chainsaws, cutting down the forests they live in.
scenes.heading: THE SAD PART
